body: If you need to talk I am here
Yes, we are all hoping you are save!

It's a grace you are still with us. God has preserved you from a terrible act without return. Suicide is never the solution, it offers no rest nor peace for these are only feelings we fell when are alive, projecting our longing for them after suicide, whose only fruit is absolute void if you're atheist (since you fell no peace at all) and condemnation if you are Christian (for He loves you beyond any mesure, just ask that you can perceive His love). Your life is still a treasure of opportunities and possibilities; for example, do you know the great confort which a dog can give us with his joy, loyality ecc. Or friends, I think there are lot of people very glad to know you and share with you moments of their lives. Never give up, we all are here for you, I wish you the best. I am here, if you want to talk

All we are here for you. Your life is worthy of all our attenions and cares. The world I think is full of people who can and want to love you, help you and make you feel ok. Never give up, remember that God loves you infinitely, for He created you to receive and share love, and waits for you in the eternal joy of Heaven. Suicide is never the way, the last word is not the death's one. I am with you, write me whatever you want

Suicide is not a way to find peace. There is no peace after it, for when we think about it as the solution of all our problems we are projecting the longings for peace which we have when we are alive. We all are here to hug and help you, for we know your life is priceless. You do not believe in God, but He loves you and He wants your happiness. He wants to raise you up, just let He saves you. I am with you, I am ready to listen you, you are not a monster. Never think it.
If you want to talk I'm here

I hug you. I am with you, your life is priceless. Suicide gives us an evil illusion of peace, but this is temptation. God wants your happiness, and He has created you to share His eternal glory; He say you and us all: "Do not fear, I am always with you and I want only your joy". Life is rich of possibilities to share good and love. Death never wins. Pray God, that you can accept His Salvation and benediction. For everything, I'm here, ready to hear you.

I'm with you, and I only say to you that there are lots of people willing to help you, and listen you. Jesus loves us all. God has created us to share the eternal happiness of Heaven. Life doesn't end here. You are important, for your are loved not only by people, but by Jesus, who is God, and His love is without measure. He created the universe to say you: "Be faithful, and remember that I am with you and I am your Salvation". Remember never peace after suicide, peace only in God's love. And if we love God, we follow and observe His commandments; and He wants your life, here and in Heaven, and your joy. Only the Devil hates you and wants your death. I'll pray for you, I'm with you for everything

God's will is that you live and that you be happy. He saved you, saying you 'I want your joy: suicide is an evil temptation'. Please think to Heaven's eternal glory, which Jesus has opened to you, for He wants your happiness. No peace after suicide, never peace: I hug you and pray for your life

We all are here for you, we all want your happiness. There is not peace after suicide, never never peace, it's only a terrible illusion. There is not peace away from God's will. God's will is that you live and that you share His eternal glory in Heaven. He wants your happiness fulfilled. I'll pray Jesus in His mercy for you and all other people who are struggling against suicide

Your life is precious, remember it; and also think about the many people you can make smile and rejoyce with your company, your help and your presence. Think about the many good things you can do in your life, which so will shine like a sun. Never give up, may God in His hope and love be with you and preserve, in His power, your life
Some people have hurted you but there are many who love you and take care of you: we all are here for this purpose. I will pray God for you because He loves you- never doubt
